Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger

after drinking all night i couldnt manage a fast enough skull to beat the curdle, tears of disgust and sadness rolling down my eyes i daret off to a little stool in the corner, sat down and covered my face and ears until the lumps of milk stopped coming up into my mouth again.
